user.title: Livelo partners
user.description: Pick the partners to follow, individually or by category. You get a notification when their points per real or campaign change. The list is checked daily at the chosen time.

data_description.categories: Every partner in these categories, including ones added later.
data_description.partners: Individual partners, in addition to the categories.
data_description.notify_services: Notification actions, e.g. the Home Assistant app on your phone. Leave empty to only fire the livelo_partner_changed and livelo_new_partner events.
data_description.notify_new_partners: Notify when any partner joins Livelo, whatever its category.
data_description.update_time: Daily check time, in Home Assistant's time zone.

abort.cannot_connect: Could not fetch the Livelo partner list.
abort.single_instance_allowed: Livelo is already configured; change it in its options.
